tool name is source data, no tool grant; exact source sorted order.
exact correct/total over actual source cases.
NaN answered_accuracy when source kept set empty; causal no_answered_cases only with verified actual kept-count/source context. NaN alone means source_nan_cause_unproven, never fabricated cause.

seconds source rounded1 decimal. Initial TrainReport.final_loss NaN; no_finite_loss_observed requires exact source trace/initial-loss evidence, not NaN alone. best_metric source null distinct from number. stop_reason already complete maps canonical already_complete; no invented new source label.
Actual producer field settings, not private historical base field; measured timing rounded3.
framework fixedmlx, source settings, measured round3; no worker data proves measurement provenance.
as_dict source params/active round3,trainable_m round1,resident_gb round1,timings3/1. BASE_BYTES etc estimates not actual hardware admission. Preserve flags; no implied measured estimate.
cached_base_gb filebytes/1e9 unrounded by overriding source; total_memory_measured fixedfalse. Unmeasured timing null; never substitute Torch resident estimate as actual total.
ordered target names source settings; no module-selector/tool authority.

Studio current config empty except car setdefault steering_magnitude .35; actual selected backend source config must match. device fixedcpu is runtime label, not node identity. versions exact gymnasium/stable-baselines3/torch.
seed10000+index source; reward additive raw score, not normalized probability; terminal flags actual bool.
source arithmetic mean over exact ordered episodes, no invented maxepisodes.
valid fixedtrue on successful source validation, not proof of arbitrary artifact/resource authenticity.
throughput already round3; exact reported F64bits, no repeated quantization.

provenance.definition: Snapshot.consumer is explicit StudioControlRunNodeRef (run + graph node + execution_generation), binding current consumer execution incarnation alongside schema/catalog/runtime source digest, manifest digest and revision. Origin.producer is separately explicit StudioControlRunNodeRef for ORIGINAL producer execution_generation; reused consumer never replaces original producer attempt. Every Text/Literal/Rows ref binds same snapshot plus exact original execution/port/manifest/content generation lineage. Port must belong to producer graph node; no equal run/node/digest without exact execution incarnation. Only Node-held all-writer-frozen actual committed bytes plus current read entitlement can mint managed refs. Producer path/worker result/cancel acknowledgement or JSON digest alone never sufficient.
provenance.current_authority: Every item/range/error current-authenticated principal/project/board/membership/resource authorized, including all reused lineage; cycle-refuse reused_from and exact fingerprints/outputs/digests. No foreign run/path/resource existence disclosure. Removed entitlement fences existing cursor. Unknown publication/child/custody means unavailable/recovery, no output from uncertain winner.

scalar_and_literal_profiles.source_string_encoding: json_string_ascii_content is canonical json.dumps(decoded source string,ensure_ascii=True) interior WITHOUT quotes. Utf8Chunk is only ASCII-byte transport; its Unicode invariant unchanged. One authoritative source decoder preserves Python codepoint sequence including lone surrogates and actual json.loads pair coalescence; no arbitrary Python-str injectivity or original token-spelling claim. No native Unicode string lossy bridge, normalization, trim or surrogate replacement. TextRef encoded_bytes/digest bind exact frozen encoded content; offsets ENCODED BYTES, python_characters separately checked after source decode. Signed decimal integer uses own exact purpose, no float/U64 coercion.
scalar_and_literal_profiles.literal_tree: Only genuine literal data ports (stream/record/structured response/tool-result/toolarguments), never metric/report/control/graph/authority bag. Flat exact Null/Bool/signeddecimal/F64/text/object/array with same immutable tree+purpose+parent+ordinal/key+childcounts. Iterative Node-admitted allocation before dereference, unique decoded keys and one root/parent, no loops/sharing/cross-resource scalar references or amplification. Literal names policy/tool/role remain inert.
scalar_and_literal_profiles.bounds: Only record_ops literals have maintained200000 UTF8bytes ensure_asciiFalse and depth>16 refusal; record_context has distinct200000 Pythoncharacter serialized view bound; decision options2..255 names<=200 source Pythoncharacters. Current arbitrary output/literal/text counts lack universal admitted aggregate profiles: no new numeric cap or 1024-list fallback. Typed RowsRef one item/snapshot read; private Node-owner admission governs transient+retained expansion, not public budget API.
scalar_and_literal_profiles.purpose: Text/Literal/Rows output-only node-issued semantic position/row kind is verified, never caller retagging or Graph/Dataset outputref cast. Inline schema/tool arguments cannot fetch schemas/plugins/network or extend tool permissions. Unknown tool result/backend extensions/schema profile returns unsupported, no opaque metric map.

numeric_semantics.representation: FiniteF64 preserves exact resulting IEEE754 binary64 bits incl negativezero/subnormals; source producer rounding already applied exactly once. Arbitrary signed integers use exact dedicated decimal text resource; booleans distinct except actual Python comparison arithmetic explicitly includes them. No clamp/drop/round/NaN=>0.
numeric_semantics.unobserved: Causal no_answered_cases/no_finite_loss_observed ONLY if exact source context proves that cause for this result; NaN alone =>source_nan_cause_unproven or explicit unsupported observation. Nullable best_metric is source null, not zero. Nonfinite unexpected fields fail appropriate profile; no success default.
numeric_semantics.comparison: Exact same-key intersection over numeric top-level fields of typed producer metrics; Python isinstance(bool,(int,float)) means dry_run bool participates. Numeric promotion/subtraction matches source arbitraryint/binary64/bool semantics; bool subtraction result is signedinteger with boolean_difference unit. Derived rows bind exact baseline/trained item refs+values+family+unit. If either input unobserved/nonfinite, retain explicit unavailable delta row with both observations/reason; no fabricated zero/drop or finite claim. Closed MetricKey covers all source numeric top-level keys, includingseed/version for Gym; unknown field/profile refuses. Delta rows must same key and semantically compatible actual units; any unresolved family unit mapping unavailable.
numeric_semantics.decision_stage: For initial assess, verify exact RAW source scores, original offered option content/order, source normalization once and stable sorting, threshold+margin threshold (ties abstain), no normalization of already-normalized/rounded public score projection. Public checked_inputs pins raw_scores/backend_request/options/order digests and both thresholds. decision.route source calls _decision on existing decision scores for choice/tie check with0 thresholds: that exact second SOURCE stage is independently pinned, not an invented additional public normalization; report retains original decision object. No third normalization or repeated rounding. Labels/gates/advisory confidence never authority.

history_semantics.actual_source: Studio run logs delegates _job_detail: rawlog last100000 bytes then UTF8replace+CRLF->LF; metric last200 successfully parsedJSON rows, arbitrary historical row keys. Canonical history snapshot is typed separate from redacted log text; source tail count/truncation observed, not new storage budget.
history_semantics.shape: Closed current Start redacted recipe/config projection,Step/Eval/Finish, nonfinite/time-budget/stall/probe notes. Start resolved params reuse exact public graph fixed recipe structs bound same source snapshot; no opaque raw resolved config/paths. Extra secret/path/internal builder config deliberately excluded in typed redacted projection, never asserted reproduced. Classifier probe exact{label,scores}; other prediction schemas need own reviewed profile. Error redaction removes paths/secrets before SafeMessage.
history_semantics.missing_unknown: HistoryRef explicit source present/missing/unknown; tail truncation flags and observedrawbytes/metricrows; UnsupportedHistory preserves source ordinal + Segment.known|unproven + reason. Unsupported/unknown/missing/tail-lost source must prevent semantic_complete true; Complete stream boundary only means supplied snapshot ended, not complete semantic history. Empty/missing observable. Unknown parsed event not silently skipped or exported as Any.
history_semantics.segments: elapsed_s belongs to each actual MetricsLog open; source read lacks durable reopen segment identity. Do NOT infer cross-segment chronology from elapsed value dropping or timestamp labels. Segment.unproven whenever actual segment identity/context cannot be established; segment+source digest required for known. No fabricated UnixMicros conversion.
history_semantics.phase_and_config: Fixed maintained classify_text/text_lm/tool_calls selected builders inspected: Built.phases default empty; no Phase constructor/phase assignment callers in retained current builders. Verified_empty_fixed_recipe requires exact recipe/backend/runtime/source profile identity, unexpected nonempty phase or changed config refuses unsupported profile, never silently dropped. Generic registered external recipes/hooks/export callbacks are not admitted by fixed Studio catalogue; no public extension bag. Current export callback absent for fixed recipes, optional exported field unavailable unless actual maintained managed artifact profile exists.

unresolved_enablement: Declaration-only: actual public Node output projection, same-custody snapshot/lineage/all-writer freezing, cross-field validation, current revocation, scalar/literal storage and private ResourceAdmission integration not implemented. No runtime/K/caller retention proof.

Mandatory vectors before enablement: source CPython float/string/surrogate/int rendering; source hash/purpose/offset exactness, absence/null/nonfinite cause fidelity; initial decision normalization vs route recheck; bool/int/F64 compare delta and unavailable rows; unit/rounding constraints.

Unbounded actual source scalar/literal/row/transient aggregate profiles need measured/admitted Node-owner limits before decode; no invented caps. GenericJSON data tree does not enable arbitrary report/metric/control extensions.

Current metric logs have no authenticated durable source-segment identity, frozen complete source snapshot or finite closed shape for all hook/phase/registered-recipe events. Unknown/missing/tail states explicit; semantic_complete must remainfalse until evidence supports it. Each new event/profile needs exact source schema, no opaque payload.

Public GraphValue/metric/run output readers are not wired into actual Studio interface; all6 operations remain declaration metadata. Graph validators, selector/expansion/callers and remaining package/import/streams/install segments stay separately incomplete as prior exact route mapping.

Private263 Studio worker DTOs stay private; public result types independently follow actual maintained producers (TorchLoRA settings correction explicit). No private stream/slot/permit/native proof issued by these public data types.
